hints.content:
###Strategy

Let's use the graph to find how much XP Iliana gets in $1$ hour. That will help us write an equation we can use to find how long it will take her to get $200$ XP.

###Unit rate and equation

Playing time (hours) | $1$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div2}$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$
:- | -: | -: | -: | -: | -:
**Total XP** | $12.5$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div2}$ | $25$ | $50$ | $75$

So Iliana gains $12.5$ XP for playing the game for $1$ hour, and we can write an equation to find how much XP Iliana gains ($p$) for any number of hours of playing time ($t$):

$p=12.5t$

And we can rewrite the equation so time ($t$) is by itself:

$t=\dfrac{p}{12.5}$

###Answer

It will take Iliana $\boxed{16}$ hours to gain $200$ total XP.
